units.source_text: 三公主自从那天遭逢了那件可悲之事以后，近来忽然觉得身体有些异样，心情很不舒畅，但也并无大病。

en.t: Ever since the Third Princess had met with that sorrowful incident, she had lately begun to feel that something was wrong with her body and her spirits were very unsettled, though she was not seriously ill.

units.source_text: 约莫一个月之后，饮食减少，脸色也发青了。

en.t: After about a month, her appetite diminished, and her complexion also turned pale and bluish.

units.source_text: 柏木不堪相思之苦，常常像做梦一般来赴幽会，三公主不胜痛苦。

en.t: Kashiwagi, unable to bear the torment of longing, often came to their secret meetings as if in a dream, and the Third Princess suffered unbearably.

units.source_text: 原来三公主一向惧怕源氏，况且讲到相貌和人品，柏木决不能和源氏相提并论。

en.t: The truth was that the Third Princess had always been afraid of Genji, and besides, in looks and character, Kashiwagi could never be mentioned in the same breath as him.

units.source_text: 柏木原也长得眉清目秀，在一般人看来，确是矫矫不群。

en.t: Kashiwagi himself was indeed handsome and refined, and in ordinary people's eyes he was certainly outstanding.

units.source_text: 但三公主自幼看惯源氏那盖世无双的优美容姿，看到柏木只觉得讨厌。

en.t: But the Third Princess had grown used since childhood to Genji's incomparable grace and beauty, so when she saw Kashiwagi she felt only revulsion.

units.source_text: 如今为这个人受苦，真是前世制定的恶命。

en.t: To suffer now because of this man was truly an ill fate ordained from a former life.

units.source_text: 乳母等看出了三公主的病由，相与诧怪道：“近来我家大人真正难得回来，怎么会……”

en.t: Her nurses and attendants perceived the cause of the Third Princess's illness and said to one another in puzzlement, "These days our lord so rarely comes back; how could this be..."

units.source_text: 她们嘟囔着，反而怪怨源氏冷淡。

en.t: They muttered among themselves and ended up blaming Genji for his coldness.

units.source_text: 源氏闻得三公主患病，这才准备回六条院去。

en.t: When Genji heard that the Third Princess was ill, he at last made preparations to return to Rokujo-in.
